item.title: Tiny Usage 1.4.0
item.description:
• Added Antigravity quota tracking (5-hour and weekly limits for both Gemini and Claude + GPT), with zero credential reads or Keychain prompts.
  • Reads the running Antigravity app's local `language_server` RPC first, and falls back to `agy -p /usage --output-format json` in an isolated temporary directory when the app is closed (with auto-updates disabled and browser launchers blocked).
  • Automatically enables Antigravity on first launch if Antigravity.app or `agy` is installed, and stays hidden otherwise; toggle it anytime in Settings or Show in menu bar.

• 新增 Antigravity 配额支持（同时展示 Gemini 与 Claude + GPT 的 5 小时和每周额度），零凭证读取、零钥匙串弹窗。
  • 优先通过运行中 Antigravity 桌面应用的本机 `language_server` RPC 获取配额；应用关闭时回退到隔离临时目录执行 `agy -p /usage --output-format json`（禁用自动更新并拦截浏览器弹窗）。
  • 首次启动检测到已安装 Antigravity.app 或 `agy` 时自动启用，未安装则默认隐藏；可在设置及「在菜单栏显示」中随时开关。

item.title: Tiny Usage 1.3.0
item.description: • Fixed the app keeping a CPU core busy the whole time it ran, which made the Mac run hot. A menu-bar redraw was re-triggered by its own result, so the icon was redrawn continuously; it now redraws only when what it shows changes. Colors still follow the menu bar's own appearance.
• 修复了 App 运行期间持续占满一个 CPU 核心、导致电脑发热的问题。菜单栏重绘会被自己的结果再次触发，图标因此不断重画；现在只在内容变化时重绘。配色仍会跟随菜单栏自身的外观变化。

item.title: Tiny Usage 1.1.1
item.description:
• Choose which of Claude, Codex, and OpenCode Go appear in the menu bar. The panel still shows all services.
  • Menu bar quota bars and percentages use a cool white when at least 50% remains. The panel still uses green for this range.

• 可分别选择是否在菜单栏显示 Claude、Codex 和 OpenCode Go。面板仍显示所有服务。
  • 剩余配额达到 50% 时，菜单栏的额度条和百分比显示冷白色。面板中这一档仍显示绿色。

item.title: Tiny Usage 1.1.0
item.description:
• Connect OpenCode Go from Settings to see your 5-hour, weekly, and monthly quotas and reset times.
  • See Claude Code quotas on first launch with your existing CLI login when fresh status-line data is unavailable.
  • Keep Codex quota readings and session history tied to the same login directory, including custom `CODEX_HOME` folders.
  • Switch between English, Simplified Chinese, and the system language in Settings.

• 可在设置中接入 OpenCode Go，查看 5 小时、每周、月度配额及重置时间。
  • 状态栏没有新数据时，可用已有的 Claude Code 登录查询配额，首次打开即可显示。
  • Codex 配额与本地会话统一使用同一登录目录，支持自定义 `CODEX_HOME`。
  • 可在设置中选择英文、简体中文或跟随系统。

item.title: Tiny Usage 1.0.0
item.description:
• First public release: Claude and Codex quotas in the menu bar, with reset times and reset credits.
  • Claude usage is read locally through Claude Code's status line; any status line you already have keeps working.
  • In-app updates. The DMG is about 1 MB.
  • English and Simplified Chinese.

• 首个公开版本：在菜单栏显示 Claude 和 Codex 配额、重置时间与重置卡。
  • 通过 Claude Code 状态栏在本地读取 Claude 用量，原有状态栏照常工作。
  • 支持应用内自动更新，DMG 约 1 MB。
  • 支持英文和简体中文。
